bugs.what: Combat feels unbalanced - missed repeatedly (d20:2, d20:4) against ash wolf despite Keen Edge perk; had to flee
Drowned chapel mentioned by innkeeper as 'east of the wood' but location never discovered despite extensive eastern exploration

confusions: Map has many repeated room descriptions (ash trees, burned ground, forks) making navigation confusing and disorienting
Three-verse system was explained but unclear if all locations are accessible or if some are hidden
No clear guidance on which direction to search for the drowned chapel or watchtower initially
suggestions: Add distinct landmark names or descriptions to reduce repetitive 'ash trees, gray light' rooms
Either balance combat better or add difficulty scaling (I had shield and keen edge but still missed frequently)
Improve navigation clarity with landmarks or a landmark system to help players locate key locations
Consider optional verses or a way to progress with partial information if drowned chapel is hard to find
